Terminal-like dashboards.

## Styles

### Night Console [1, 2]

**Composition:** Dense rows of monospaced data on near-black, grouped by thin rules [1, 2].

**Do:** Align every figure on a grid [2].

**Don't:** Use more than two signal colors [1].

**Use it for:** Monitoring and logs [1, 2].
